Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bid Validity The offer shall remain valid for 180 days from the bid end date. 2. Quantity Variation The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the ordered quantity by up to 25% of the contrac ted quantity at the contracted rates, subject to applicable GeM terms and conditions. 3. Delivery Schedule – Staggered Supply The successful bidder shall supply the contracted quantity in three instalments as per the staggered delive ry schedule specified in the bid: first instalment 60 cans (delivery within 10 days of the contract start date ), second instalment 60 cans (delivery from day 80 to day 90), third instalment 61 cans (delivery from day 170 to day 180). The applicable GeM terms and conditions shall govern delayed delivery. 4. Product Specification – Glutaraldehyde Solution with Liquid Activator The required product shall be a high-level disinfectant solution containing 2.45% glutaraldehyde, in 5-litre cans, supplied with a separate liquid activator, suitable for hospital instrument disinfection. After activatio n/mixing with the activator, the validity of the solution shall be a minimum of 28 days. The product shall be supplied with the required liquid activator and clear manufacturer instructions for activation, use, monitori ng and post-activation validity. A ready-to-use product that does not require the specified liquid activator s hall not be treated as equivalent. 5. Supply Restrictions The successful bidder shall supply only the product and quantities specified in the GeM contract. No substit ute formulation, ready-to-use alternative or different product shall be supplied without prior written approv al from the Competent Authority.

6. Invoice and Payment The successful bidder shall upload invoices on the GeM portal for the quantities actually supplied and acce pted by the hospital, in accordance with the applicable GeM terms and conditions. 7. Inspection and Acceptance The supplied product shall be inspected and verified by the designated hospital officials for conformity wit h the specified formulation, concentration, packaging, quantity, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date and availability of the required liquid activator and manufacturer's instructions. Acceptance shall be s ubject to satisfactory verification. 8. Expiry, Rejection and Replacement Expired, damaged, leaking, defective or non-conforming products, including supplies without the required l iquid activator, shall be liable for rejection. The successful bidder shall replace rejected supplies at no addi tional cost, subject to the applicable GeM terms and conditions. The product shall meet the minimum rema ining shelf-life requirement specified in the bid. 9. Compliance with Technical Specifications The successful bidder shall supply the product strictly in accordance with the technical specifications and r equirements stipulated in the bid and the resulting GeM contract. Any deviation from the specified formula tion or activation requirements shall be dealt with under the applicable GeM terms and conditions. 10. Acceptance of Terms and Conditions The bidder shall submit a duly signed and stamped undertaking on the firm’s letterhead confirming accept ance of the applicable bid terms and conditions, wherever required by the bid. Failure to submit a mandato ry undertaking may result in rejection, subject to applicable GeM terms and procurement rules. 11. Declaration of Relatives/Financial Interest The bidder shall submit the duly signed and stamped Declaration of Relatives/Financial Interest in the form at prescribed in Annexure-I, on the firm's letterhead. The bidder shall disclose the applicable information a nd indicate "Nil" wherever no relevant relationship or financial interest exists. Any action arising from a fal se declaration or non-disclosure shall be governed by the applicable rules and bid conditions.
